schema.text: Is there enough safe space to wait before crossing or to stop and rest?
schema.help: A waiting or stopping space is an area outside moving traffic where people can stand before crossing or pause along the way.

options.text: A place exists, but it is too small
No waiting or stopping space is needed here

en.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: Is there enough safe space to wait before crossing or to stop and rest?
en.#A waiting or stopping space is an area: A waiting or stopping space is an area outside moving traffic where people can stand before crossing or pause along the way.
en.#A place exists, but it is too small: A place exists, but it is too small
en.#No waiting or stopping space is needed: No waiting or stopping space is needed here

it.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: C'è abbastanza spazio sicuro per aspettare prima di attraversare o per fermarsi a riposare?
it.#A waiting or stopping space is an area: Uno spazio di attesa o sosta è un’area fuori dal traffico in movimento dove le persone possono fermarsi prima di attraversare o lungo il percorso.
it.#A place exists, but it is too small: C'è uno spazio, ma è troppo piccolo
it.#No waiting or stopping space is needed: Qui non serve uno spazio di attesa o fermata

fr.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: Y a-t-il assez d'espace sûr pour attendre avant de traverser ou pour s'arrêter et se reposer ?
fr.#A waiting or stopping space is an area: Un espace d’attente ou d’arrêt est une zone hors de la circulation où les personnes peuvent se tenir avant de traverser ou s’arrêter en chemin.
fr.#A place exists, but it is too small: Il existe un espace, mais il est trop petit
fr.#No waiting or stopping space is needed: Aucun espace d’attente ou d’arrêt n’est nécessaire ici

de.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: Gibt es genug sicheren Platz, um vor dem Überqueren zu warten oder anzuhalten und sich auszuruhen?
de.#A waiting or stopping space is an area: Ein Warte- oder Haltebereich ist eine Fläche außerhalb des fließenden Verkehrs, auf der Menschen vor dem Queren stehen oder unterwegs anhalten können.
de.#A place exists, but it is too small: Es gibt einen Platz, aber er ist zu klein
de.#No waiting or stopping space is needed: Hier wird kein Warte- oder Haltebereich benötigt

tr.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: Karşıya geçmeden önce beklemek veya durup dinlenmek için yeterli güvenli alan var mı?
tr.#A waiting or stopping space is an area: Bekleme veya durma alanı, insanların karşıya geçmeden önce durabildiği ya da yol boyunca soluklanabildiği, hareketli trafiğin dışındaki alandır.
tr.#A place exists, but it is too small: Bir yer var, ancak çok küçük
tr.#No waiting or stopping space is needed: Burada bekleme veya durma alanı gerekmiyor

fa.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: آیا فضای امن کافی برای انتظار پیش از عبور یا توقف و استراحت وجود دارد؟
fa.#A waiting or stopping space is an area: فضای انتظار یا توقف محدوده‌ای خارج از ترافیک در حرکت است که افراد می‌توانند پیش از عبور یا در طول مسیر در آن بایستند.
fa.#A place exists, but it is too small: جایی وجود دارد، اما خیلی کوچک است
fa.#No waiting or stopping space is needed: در اینجا فضای انتظار یا توقف لازم نیست

hu.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: Van-e elég biztonságos hely várakozni az átkelés előtt, vagy megállni pihenni?
hu.#A waiting or stopping space is an area: A várakozó- vagy megállóhely a forgalmon kívül eső terület, ahol az emberek átkelés előtt vagy útközben megállhatnak.
hu.#No waiting or stopping space is needed: Itt nincs szükség várakozó- vagy megállóhelyre

ar.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: هل توجد مساحة آمنة كافية للانتظار قبل العبور أو للتوقف والاستراحة؟
ar.#A waiting or stopping space is an area: مساحة الانتظار أو التوقف هي منطقة خارج حركة المرور يمكن للناس الوقوف فيها قبل العبور أو التوقف خلال الطريق.
ar.#No waiting or stopping space is needed: لا حاجة إلى مساحة انتظار أو توقف هنا
